audit_items.proof_trace: The `syncRoles` handler fetches a member via `.eq('discord_uid', discord_uid).single<Member>()` without any `.is('deleted_at', null)` filter, so a soft-deleted member record is returned and all 6 role-sync steps proceed. This is inconsistent with `syncAllRoles` (rolesSyncAll.ts:L16-19) and `getAllMembers` (members.ts:L18), both of which explicitly filter deleted members — confirming the omission is not intentional design. Exploitation requires a valid `API_AUTH_TOKEN` bearer secret, making full external exploitation conditional.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated caller sends `POST /api/roles/sync` with the `discord_uid` of a soft-deleted member; `syncRoles` retrieves the deactivated record and re-applies Discord roles (including the 'verified' role) to a member who should be barred from the server.
